notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 local object-instance deletion surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies pre-connect and pre-join service boundaries, ownership and pending-acquisition protection, successful local deletion from a fresh requester, rediscovery and stable identity lookups, continued ordinary attribute reflection, and standard resignation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador local object-instance deletion, object publication/subscription, ownership acquisition, update, lookup, and resignation services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
